caption: The drawing contains five distinct hardware objects, each outlined in black ink and labeled with a legend below the central image. The first object, marked as "1," is a horizontal rectangular slide bolt with a metal latch mechanism, featuring a series of screws or rivets along its edges. The second object, marked as "2," is an L-shaped window holder, shown adjacent to a sketched window in the upper center of the image. The third object, labeled "3," is a vertically oriented decorative hinge with curving, ornamental features, and circular ends, set to the left of the central composition. The fourth object, marked "4," is a long, narrow, and slightly curved door latch with a looped and screw-mounted end, positioned to the right of the central area. The fifth object, labeled "5," is a flat, elongated strap hinge with three round holes, located horizontally at the bottom of the drawing. In the center, there is a colored illustration of a rustic scene, depicting a building façade, greenery, and a blue sky with portions of the structures rendered in shades of brown, green, and yellow. The rest of the drawing is in monochrome black and white, and the objects are arranged symmetrically around the central illustration and legend.
title: Iron Hardware
